title: Rabbi Berekhyah bar Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 53:8, but Hyman says the reading should be “in the name of Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bereshit Rabbah 53:8 has Rabbi Berekhyah beRabbi Yehudah beRabbi Simon, followed by “in the name of Rabbi Shmuel beRabbi Yitzchak.” Changing the first patronymic formula to “in the name of” is Hyman’s proposal.

The full titles in the heading and body have local support in the saved Midrash Rabbah -- TE Bereshit Rabbah53 paragraph. The heading keeps Hyman’s untitled Yehudah even though the digital formula titles Yehudah as well. The digital paragraph reads a patronymic chain followed by a separate in-the-name-of formula, as the existing note records. Hyman’s should-read correction remains his proposal with its full force; the digital text is not silently emended, and the heading is not converted into a new teacher relationship or authority identity. The existing note remains verbatim. No other teaching, miracle claim or additional figures from the paragraph are imported. This is digital evidence, not proof of printed lettering or correction history.
